description.value: The Story Café is a full-service eatery and bar in Richmond, BC, built inside a converted 30-year-old warehouse around the philosophy that 'there is a story in everything.' The venue combines coffee, prime steaks, exquisite wines, live music nights, and a curated collection of antiques and vintage objects into a single atmospheric space. A heated, dog-friendly patio extends the dining experience outdoors, and private dining and online ordering are also available.

No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere in the fetched content or OSM tags, so those fields remain null. The website displays the phone as '604 My Story' (a stylized vanity reference), which does not allow full numeric confirmation of the OSM phone value.
